strategy.overview: Mariner and Sea Ray build a 10,000-point Bonus that must be collected during the ball. Shoot the center yellow mushroom bumper when it is worth at least 3,000 to raise the center post, then use the upper playfield to build Bonus and enter the right collect chute before the ball ends.
strategy.simpleOverview: In Mariner or Sea Ray, hit the center yellow mushroom bumper when it shows 3,000 or more; that raises the center post. Build Bonus up top, then collect it at the top saucer or right-side chute. Bonus does not score automatically when the ball drains.
strategy.summary: Raise the post before taking risks, build Bonus with green bumpers, white rollovers, and lit targets, then cash it through the right chute or top saucer. The left award chute can open the right outlane gate, light bumpers, or light Extra Ball.

quickInfo.name: Center yellow bumper
quickInfo.summary: Scores its changing 1,000–5,000 value and raises the center post.

quickInfo.name: Build Bonus
quickInfo.summary: Green mushroom bumpers, white top rollovers, and indicated standups add Bonus to a 10,000 maximum.

quickInfo.name: Collect Bonus
quickInfo.summary: Use the top saucer or either entrance to the right-side collect chute; Bonus then resets to 1,000.

quickInfo.name: Left award chute
quickInfo.summary: Can raise the post, open the right gate, light blue bumpers, or light Extra Ball.

steps.text: Plunge across the top white rollovers and try to finish in the top center saucer for an immediate Bonus collect.
Hit the center yellow mushroom bumper when its lamp shows 3,000 or more to raise the center post.
Settle the ball against the raised post, then return it up top to build Bonus.
At high Bonus, nudge upper-playfield action toward the right-side collect chute or take the top saucer.
Rebuild after each collect; do not carry uncollected Bonus into a drain.
Raise the center post with a valuable yellow-bumper hit.
Build Bonus in the upper playfield.
Collect through the right chute or top saucer before draining.

machineSetup: Confirm three- or five-ball play, Extra Ball conversion, and the cycling values and awards currently installed for the center bumper and left chute.
Test the center post and down-post switches, three mushroom bumpers, top white rollovers, lit standups, top saucer, both right-chute entrances, left award chute, and right outlane gate.
